Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production inventory ICON ATLAS for VARENDOR realistic medieval dark fantasy MMORPG. Create ONE SQUARE PNG 2048x2048, precisely FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows, sixteen equal 512 square cells, no gutters, no outer margins, no labels and no letters, numbers, words, watermarks anywhere. Each cell has a very thin aged bronze square border aligned at its edges, and uniform near-black charcoal background. One DIFFERENT centered fully visible inventory item per requested cell. Item occupies about 76% of the cell, with clear strong readable silhouette for eventual 36px icon; 3/4 view professionally hand-painted realistic PBR quality. Worn steel, leather, engraved metal, restrained magical accents; believable medieval armor and equipment related to a massive realistic Forgotten Knight. NO cartoon, no flat symbols, no UI numbers, no character wearing armor. Chest armor is a separate torso garment with an empty neck, helmets separate, pairs of gloves or boots in their cell. Weapons diagonal. A small bright bevel with warm key light, dark atmospheric shadows; premium readable fantasy game inventory illustration. Higher rift equipment has restrained orange ember or frosty-blue inlays; shadow assassin leather dark purple-black; warden equipment heavier engraved steel. Exact row-major cell content:
Row 1, column 1: Меч северного дозора (wardens_blade; weapon).
Row 1, column 2: Посох тлеющего камня (ember_staff; weapon).
Row 1, column 3: Парные костяные клинки (bone_fangs; weapon).
Row 1, column 4: Лук Чёрного леса (blackwood_bow; weapon).
Row 2, column 1: Гримуар Последнего вздоха (mourn_grimoire; weapon).
Row 2, column 2: Латы пограничной стражи (militia_plate; chest).
Row 2, column 3: Мантия пепельного оракула (oracle_robe; chest).
Row 2, column 4: Теневой панцирь (night_leather; chest).
Row 3, column 1: Куртка чёрного следопыта (tracker_coat; chest).
Row 3, column 2: Облачение костяного хора (bone_raiment; chest).
Row 3, column 3: Перчатки Серой стаи (wolf_gloves; gloves).
Row 3, column 4: Сапоги могильщика (grave_boots; boots).
Row 4, column 1: Шлем павшего командира (fallen_helm; head).
Row 4, column 2: Кольцо тлеющего угля (ember_ring; ring).
Row 4, column 3: Ожерелье волчьих клыков (fang_necklace; neck).
Row 4, column 4: Пояс Пепельной клятвы (ash_belt; belt).
All sixteen cells must maintain exact equal grid alignment. Any empty cells stay empty. Match the same realistic dark brass-framed game icon set throughout.
